summary: The recorded base still allowed non-quantized native Transformers fallback to materialize a CPU-offloaded text encoder before consulting the effective CPU-start policy. The exact candidate passes a CPU device_map into from_pretrained for component-offload and layerwise-offload CPU-start decisions, including indexed text-encoder keys, while preserving resident and quantized behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before structural reproduction: explicit/component-offload, layerwise-equivalent, and text_encoder_2 cases never queried should_start_component_on_cpu and passed no device_map. Resident behavior was also recorded; quantized loading retained its existing CUDA device map.
Candidate regression and resident/quantized boundary coverage: 3 passed, 51 deselected.

Independent adversarial policy cases: explicit/component offload, layerwise-equivalent, and text_encoder_2 each passed a CPU device_map; resident passed none; quantized precedence remained GPU-resident.
Real local Transformers from_pretrained placement on AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950: all parameters were on CPU and torch.cuda.memory_allocated remained 0 bytes before and after loading.
Related fallback and component-identity coverage: 11 passed and 12 subtests passed.

gpu_execution_evidence: Generated tiny T5 fixture loaded through the changed native Transformers path on AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2; parameters stayed on CPU and PyTorch GPU allocation delta was 0 bytes.
remaining_limitations: Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers and Efficient-Large-Model/Sana_600M_512px_diffusers weights were unavailable, so the exact full diffusion fallback and denoising paths were not run.
The reporter used an 8GB NVIDIA RTX 4070 Laptop under CUDA/WSL2; the assigned device is a 256GB AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 under ROCm 7.2, so the exact CUDA OOM was not reproduced.
The tiny T5 fixture validates native Transformers placement and allocator behavior only, not model-architecture semantics or generation accuracy.
No native source changed; native rebuild was inapplicable.
